stem.text: Two cells are investigated using a potentiometer. At the balance point, cell X gives a reading of $44\,\text{cm}$ and cell Y gives a reading of $70\,\text{cm}$.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit with cell X, a 6 V cell, a resistor labelled R, a wire with a sliding contact, and a galvanometer; the balance length of 44 cm is marked.
stem.label: X

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit with cell Y, a 6 V cell, a resistor labelled R, a wire with a sliding contact, and a galvanometer; the balance length of 70 cm is marked.
stem.label: Y

A.text: A potentiometer balance point results in zero current through the galvanometer.

B.text: At the balance point, the current through resistor R in both circuits is the same.

C.text: The electromotive force (e.m.f.) of cell X is larger than that of cell Y.

D.text: The value of the e.m.f. of each of the cells X and Y is less than $6\,\text{V}$.
